verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only developer API endpoints, such as retrieving option grants, fair market values, and an FMV API for calculating exercise tax implications, plus partner and MCP integrations. These are building blocks a developer could use, not a first-party employee portal. Nothing in the pack shows employees getting their own view of grants, vesting progress, strike price, or outcome modeling, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes
